name: Microsoft Dynamics CRM
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the Microsoft Dynamics CRM node to automate work in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, and integrate Microsoft Dynamics CRM with other applications. n8n has built-in support for creating, updating, deleting, and getting Microsoft Dynamics CRM accounts
